exported_guarantees.statement: Canonical world truth and actor belief are distinct authorities; actors do not gain truth merely because the engine has it.
Missing actor knowledge remains UNKNOWN and must not fall back to canonical truth.
Perception, communication, accessed public sources and explicit bounded authored or inference seams are legitimate acquisition causes; ambient truth is not.
Actor belief may be false, stale or partial until an explicit epistemic cause revises it; canonical truth mutation alone does not synchronize beliefs.
Truth comparison and stale/false diagnostics are privileged tooling outputs and cannot enter ordinary actor decision or dialogue inputs.
Immediate acquisition provenance and revision time are retained for explanation without turning PA-04 into unbounded transfer or autobiographical history.
With non-epistemic inputs fixed, two actors in the same canonical world may hold different justified beliefs and therefore make different explainable decisions.
Normal actor knowledge lookup must not depend on a global actor/fact scan.

exclusions_nonclaims.statement: Actor-visible isTrue/isFalse/isStale or equivalent privileged canonical comparison is rejected.
Automatic canonical truth to actor-belief synchronization is rejected.
Duplicated dialogue or quest knows_X state is rejected as a parallel epistemic authority.
General recursive Theory of Mind is rejected as a baseline requirement.
An LLM or general reasoner is rejected as canonical belief authority.
Unbounded provenance chains inside each belief are rejected; PA-05 and PA-06 retain their own boundaries.
PA-04 does not select the final runtime database, persistence model, API, numerical confidence formula, dialogue integration or perception implementation.

reopen_conditions: Concrete contradictory evidence shows an effective actor decision path cannot preserve canonical truth and ActorBelief as separate authorities.
A later accepted consumer requires actor-visible privileged truth comparison rather than an explicit acquisition path.
A later accepted composition with PA-05 or PA-06 reveals that bounded immediate provenance cannot remain separate from transfer or autobiographical history.
escalate_if: A consumer needs exact PA-04 semantics beyond the exported guarantees and complete disposition table.
A disposition would be reclassified, especially any REJECT or LATER/conditional row.
A proposed consumer introduces automatic truth synchronization, actor-visible truth diagnostics, duplicated knowledge authority or global lookup.
Live accepted identity or canonical PA-04 source bytes contradict this capsule.

dispositions.source_key: canonical truth separate from actor belief
actor-local belief/access keyed by actor + proposition/facet
accessed public source as acquisition cause
authored initial/grant knowledge with traceable rule
bounded named inference from accessible inputs
unbounded provenance chain inside each belief
global actor/fact scan for normal knowledge lookup
